_readme: Per-creator monthly booking reconciliation, keyed by the creator's telemetry slug (cr-<handle>). Updated monthly from the GetYourGuide partner report: filter campaigns beginning 'cr-', and for each, fill {bookings, gross, commission, status, updated}. Commission = 4% of gross (the creator's half of what GetYourGuide pays OceanSafe), flat at every volume — no tier, no threshold. The creator dashboard reads this file by slug. Example: "cr-chadkoga": {"bookings": 3, "gross": 1240, "commission": 49.60, "status": "accruing — pays out over $25", "updated": "2026-08-01"} Optionally add "history": [{"period":"July 2026","bookings":4,"gross":1940,"commission":77.60,"paid":false,"paid_on":"Jul 5"}] — newest first. The dashboard renders it as a month-by-month statement; without it the snapshot above shows as the single open period.
